label: An ML lab in one live space: a run launched, watched, steered, read and compared, then charted on a new page and stopped by a rule written on the spot.

chapters.title: Open the lab
chapters.note: Runs, tools and notes, one live space.

chapters.title: Launch a run
chapters.note: It trains as a job, in its own process.

chapters.title: Watch it learn
chapters.note: Curves, digits and weights redraw as it trains.

chapters.title: Steer it
chapters.note: Drag the rate. The job reads it next chunk.

chapters.title: Use the model
chapters.note: Checkpoints live in the space. Any page reads them.

chapters.title: Compare runs
chapters.note: Every run side by side, the live one still drawing.

chapters.title: Take notes
chapters.note: A new page: your notes beside every run, live.

chapters.title: Write a rule
chapters.note: A few lines on the live run: stop when good.

chapters.title: Everything follows
chapters.note: Lower the bar. The run stops, every page knows.
